name: pr_fanout stops accumulating, so every bulk edit reads as a single-document PR

name: render_threads lets CANNOT RUN read as an honest absence
expect: an unreadable history says so instead of showing nothing

name: doc_stem strips a suffix anywhere, not only at the end

name: pair_documents drops the extra document instead of keeping it for the renderer

name: git_pr_history reports a git it could not launch as an honest empty history
expect: a git that cannot be launched at all is CANNOT RUN

name: git_show_files reports a git it could not launch as an empty file list
